name: Order Independent Transparency for Point-Based Models
definition: A multi-pass approach to render transparent point-based models on GPUs in an order-independent manner, extending depth-peeling to deferred shaded multipass splatting.
summary: Order Independent Transparency for Point-Based Models renders transparent splats without depth sorting by iteratively reconstructing a fixed number of layers using depth-peeling, avoiding expensive sorting at the cost of potential color loss if the layer limit is exceeded.
